05 — How I work

Idea to post. All by me.

  1. Idea
  2. →
  3. Execution
  4. →
  5. Distribution
  6. →
  7. Analysis

Idea

I track trending reels, competitor content and the questions followers ask, then pick topics that are timely and worth making. Visa and policy news gets checked against official sources first.

Idea

I write a short script with a strong hook in the first 2–3 seconds, then the key point, then a clear call to action. Captions and on-screen text are planned here too.

Execution

I shoot the video myself, handling framing, lighting, audio and b-roll. Vertical 9:16 for reels, with a shot list so nothing is missed on set.

Execution

I edit in CapCut and Premiere Pro with tight cuts, subtitles, music and transitions. Motion graphics in After Effects where the story needs it.

Execution

I design posters, carousels and thumbnails in Canva, Photoshop and Illustrator. Each one follows the brand look, with clear text and a layout that’s easy to read on a phone.

Distribution

I plan a content calendar and post at the times the audience is most active. Caption, hashtags and cover image are finalised before going live.

Analysis

I review views, shares, saves and retention for each post. What works gets repeated, and what doesn’t gets reworked in the next round.
